notes: True bit-perfect on macOS (revision 2): exclusive output locks the hardware physical format using the device own available ASBD flags, preferring the NonMixable (0x40) integer variant, and verifies nsrt/sfmt/pft three-layer rate equality on every status poll so a mid-playback rate change degrades the badge immediately. Endpoints whose physical layer offers only float32 keep playing but report not bit-perfect with the reason. Hog exclusive defaults on and its hint states that Hog does not block other apps. · macOS 真 bit-perfect（修订二）：独占路径用设备 available 档的原样 ASBD 标志锁定物理格式，同率同位深时优先选带 NonMixable(0x40) 的整数档；并在每次状态轮询核对 nsrt/sfmt/pft 三层同率，播放中设备率被改回去时徽标当场降级。物理层只有 float32 的端点照常播放但如实报「非 bit-perfect」并给出理由。Hog 独占默认开启，提示文案已更正为「Hog 不能阻止其它 App 播放」。
